title: Adaptive bitrate monitor
blurb: Polls getStats() on a configurable interval, pushes real bidirectional stream load, plots smoothedRtt, minRtt, and estimatedSendRate on an accessible SVG chart, pauses on hidden tabs, and picks a video quality tier while holding on null estimates.
question: Can polling WebTransport.getStats() while pushing bidirectional stream traffic drive a live adaptive bitrate tier selector from estimatedSendRate and queueing delay (smoothedRtt vs minRtt)?
result: On Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats against a local Deno QUIC echo server, echoing ~330 MB over bidirectional streams in 3 s raised estimatedSendRate and updated the SVG chart and tier indicator; the null-estimate hold branch was not triggered on loopback. Not verified unflagged in Chrome 160.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153 behind --enable-blink-features=WebTransportStats (local Deno QUIC echo server); not verified unflagged in Chrome 160
